name: localhost-image-finder
description: Local workbook image finder with Google API-key model agents and a pixel office progress view

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js && npm run build:webview
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production && npm run build:webview
scripts.lint: eslint server/src/env.ts server/src/gemini.ts server/src/google.ts server/src/httpServer.ts server/src/index.ts server/src/jobManager.ts server/src/types.ts server/src/workbook.ts server/__tests__/local-*.test.ts shared && cd webview-ui && npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix: eslint server/src/env.ts server/src/gemini.ts server/src/google.ts server/src/httpServer.ts server/src/index.ts server/src/jobManager.ts server/src/types.ts server/src/workbook.ts server/__tests__/local-*.test.ts shared --fix && cd webview-ui && npm run lint -- --fix
scripts.test: npm run test:webview && npm run test:server
